Once upon a time, there was a red city. It was full of tall buildings, people, cars and buses. One day, the whole city got very cold. Everything outside started to freeze! All the trees, the roads and even the people!

The people were feeling so chilly they shivered. Some of them even turned into ice lollies!

Everyone was so scared, but then a brave little boy called Jake stepped out into the cold. He held his hands up and said "Stop! Please unfreeze the city".

Suddenly, the cold stopped and all the people were no longer icy.

As he got closer, he saw that it was a beautiful butterfly with colorful wings. Tim was so happy to see such a pretty butterfly! He watched it for a while and then it flew away. Tim was sad to see it go, but he was happy that he got to see it up close.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play with his toys and run around outside. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a test to see how much he knew. Timmy tried his best to answer the questions, but he didn't do very well.

Timmy felt sad and didn't want to act happy anymore. He wished he could be more flexible like his toys. Suddenly, Timmy had an idea. He decided to try and be more like his toys by jumping and bending like they do.

Timmy jumped and bent so much that he hurt himself.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl called Sue.

Sue lived in a big house and everyday she would read some words. Every day the number of words she could read would increase a bit more.

One day Sue wanted to read even more words and she decided to go on an adventure. 

Sue grabbed her book and went out of the house. She walked and walked until she reached a big castle. 

When Sue arrived to the castle she knocked on the door and said:

"Hello! Can I please have some more words so I can read them?".
